review.subject: Frosted glass fragrance bottle on wet leaves and citrus slices
review.summary: A bottle lies on a bed of dewy leaves and cut citrus, tumbles and rotates through the frame, settles upright, then pushes into a macro of the cap with a dripping droplet before a logo end card on black. Looks like AI-generated or CGI imagery animated with slow digital push-ins and rotations; the contact sheet is clear but the last two frames are a mostly black logo card.

beats.note: Bottle flat on wet leaves and citrus, slow push-in makes the label read larger.
Bottle tumbles and rotates across the foliage bed, then rights itself upright, pull-out.
Hard cut to a tight static close-up of the cap and label with a water bead dripping.
Cut to black with the brand mark appearing twice in small boxes.

shot_labels.note: Bottle on leaves and citrus, linear push-in about 14% zoom
Bottle spins and settles upright, decelerating pull-out
Static macro of cap and dripping droplet, shallow depth
Black logo card with fast pop-in at the cut

learn: Start on a lush, saturated world (leaves, citrus, water beads) so the neutral product pops, and hold the first shot a full 3.5s with a slow linear push-in of about 14%.
Give the hero a second beat of motion (tumble and settle) in a 3.9s shot with an ease-out so it lands calmly upright.
Cut to a static macro for about 1.5s on a tactile detail such as a water drip to sell freshness.
Close with a 1s black logo card; a hard cut from macro to end card keeps the ending crisp.
